Dr. Monte, CMP, CMPT, is a Doctor of Physical Therapy with advanced post-graduate certifications in Kinesio Taping, Manual Therapy, Dry Needling, and more. After years of clinical practice, he created Geeked Rehab as a way to share a passion for rehabilitation, movement, and evidence-based recovery with a wider community.

Geeked Rehab exists to break down the walls of the PT clinic and bring expert-level rehab knowledge directly to you.
Our mission is to educate and empower the general public with clear, practical demonstrations of the same techniques used in physical therapy clinics—adapted for safe, effective home rehab.

Your engagement drives this channel. The more questions and feedback we receive, the better we can tailor videos.

Don’t hesitate—drop your questions, request specific topics, and join the growing Geeked Rehab community. We’re here to help you take control of your rehab journey with clarity, confidence, and expert guidance.
